currentContext.business: Following approval and implementation of a Resolution Plan by the Hon'ble NCLT, new management has assumed control of the Company. The Board's Report states the Company intends to build on its legacy in the steel industry by transforming steel from a commodity into a value-added service offering and by leveraging its expertise in the production of high-quality long steel products. In parallel it intends to diversify by establishing a venture studio model that creates, incubates and scales businesses from the ground up and makes strategic investments in high-potential startups, offering entrepreneurs operational support, strategic guidance and access to a network of industry experts, investors and business leaders. The MD&A separately states the Company operates in a single segment, namely India's Power Transmission and Telecom Infrastructure space.

Steel: Long steel products (high-quality long steel products, per the Board's Report)

currentContext.strengths: Legacy and stated expertise in the production of high-quality long steel products (Board's Report)|Balance sheet reset via an NCLT-approved Resolution Plan with new management in control (Board's Report)|Group structure of four wholly owned subsidiaries (Neueon Power, Neueon Global, Neueon Enterprises, Digitech Business Systems Hong Kong) forming the Neueon Group|Management asserts the Company has 'cutting-edge business and better than contemporary products' - a self-assessment in the MD&A, not independently evidenced
currentContext.strategies: Build on the Company's legacy in the steel industry by transforming steel from a commodity into a value-added service offering, and by leveraging its expertise in the production of high-quality long steel products.|Diversify the business portfolio by establishing a venture studio model that creates, incubates and scales businesses from the ground up while making strategic investments in high-potential startups.|Go beyond providing financial capital by partnering closely with entrepreneurs - offering operational support, strategic guidance and access to a network of industry experts, investors and business leaders.|Complete the turnaround begun with the NCLT-approved Resolution Plan: restructuring, implementation of the Resolution Plan and cost optimisation initiatives (Chairman's message).|MD's stated priorities: strengthening operational capabilities, enhancing financial performance, expanding business opportunities and creating sustainable long-term value for all stakeholders.|Treat marketing and revenue generation as the top-most priority - retune marketing strategies, involve the agencies responsible for promotion and revenue during product conceptualisation, and use reputed market research teams before embarking on product development.|Strengthen HR management discipline - discipline, compensation, reward/redressal schemes and career progression.|Make meeting financial obligations in terms of profitability and healthy cash flows the organisation's core objective, with all activities aligned to it.
currentContext.expansion: The annual report describes no plant, capacity or physical capex programme. The only expansion narrative is corporate and strategic: following the NCLT-approved Resolution Plan and the change of control, the Company says it will build on its legacy in steel by turning steel from a commodity into a value-added service offering and by leveraging its expertise in high-quality long steel products, and will diversify by establishing a venture studio model that creates, incubates and scales businesses from the ground up while making strategic investments in high-potential startups. The Board's Report states there is no change in the nature of the business of the Company or any of its subsidiaries or associates during the year, that the Company has no material subsidiary under Regulation 16(1)(c) of the SEBI Listing Regulations, and that there are no material changes or commitments affecting the financial position of the Company between March 31, 2026 and the date of the Report (July 31, 2026). No commissioning date, ramp-up timeline, new site, capacity addition or acquisition is disclosed.
currentContext.mdna: The Company states it operates in a single segment, namely India's Power Transmission and Telecom Infrastructure space.|Chairman notes the business environment through FY26 continued to be influenced by legal proceedings, geopolitical uncertainties, market volatility and persistent supply chain disruptions that impacted industries globally.|MD&A states the Company reported a significant increase in revenue for the year but incurred a net loss primarily attributable to an impairment loss.|MD&A frames marketing and revenue generation - not product capability - as the historic constraint on the business, claiming the Company has cutting-edge business and better-than-contemporary products.|Chairman and MD both credit the holding company, Neueon Consol Private Limited, with leading the revival and restructuring and laying the foundation for future growth.

risks.risk: Qualified audit opinion - impairment testing not performed under Ind AS 36
risks.note: The statutory auditor qualified the standalone opinion because the Company did not perform impairment testing of Property, Plant and Equipment, investments and other financial assets despite the presence of impairment indicators; the auditor states the Company 'has recognized impairment loss in respect of fixed assets amounting to Rs.58,748.44 lakhs' but that 'the impairment assessment has not been supported by adequate documentation and appropriate determination of recoverable amount as required under Ind AS 36'.

risks.risk: Carrying value of assets not auditable
risks.note: In the absence of sufficient and appropriate audit evidence on the assumptions used in estimating future cash flows and discount rates, and in the absence of an impairment assessment or external valuation, the auditor says it is unable to determine whether any adjustment is necessary to the carrying value of PPE, investments and other financial assets - so reported asset values may not be reliable.

risks.risk: Insolvency / Resolution Plan implementation still an open audit matter
risks.note: The Basis for Qualified Opinion carries a second head, 'Implementation of status of the Resolution plan', noting the Company was admitted into corporate insolvency, and the auditor adds an Emphasis of Matter drawing attention to Note 1 of the financial statements. Execution of the NCLT-approved plan under new management is therefore not yet a closed item.

risks.risk: Marketing and revenue generation is the acknowledged structural weak link
risks.note: MD&A: 'The weak-link of your company historically has been the Marketing and Revenue generation despite the fact that the company has cutting-edge business and better than contemporary products. This gap needs to be bridged forthwith as the top most priority.' Revenue is very small relative to the cost base, so the demand-side gap is the core going-concern issue.

MD&A states the Company operates in a single segment, India's Power Transmission and Telecom Infrastructure space, with no product, customer or geographic diversification disclosed - leaving earnings exposed to one end-market and one country.

The Board's Report describes a steel business pivoting to steel-as-a-service plus a venture studio investing in startups, while the MD&A describes a single segment in power transmission and telecom infrastructure. The two stated identities are not reconciled anywhere in the report, and the venture studio is an unproven model with no disclosed capital plan, timeline or team.

risks.risk: Human resources management discipline needs strengthening
risks.note: MD&A flags that HR management 'needs to be strengthened in a large measure' to manage discipline, compensation, reward/redressal schemes and career progression - a capability gap for a company attempting a turnaround and a new venture-investing business.

risks.risk: Board and management churn during the turnaround
risks.note: Corporate Information records a new Chairman & Non-Executive Director appointed w.e.f. 21 Nov 2025, a Wholetime Director resigned w.e.f. 07 Nov 2025 and an Independent Woman Director resigned w.e.f. 03 Jan 2026 - substantial board turnover in the same year control changed under the Resolution Plan.

risks.risk: External environment: legal proceedings, geopolitics, volatility and supply chain
risks.note: The Chairman states the business environment through FY2025-26 continued to be influenced by legal proceedings, geopolitical uncertainties, market volatility and persistent supply chain disruptions.
